title: Comparison in If
concept: Use comparison operators in if conditions to make decisions based on relationships between values.
why: Most real conditions involve comparing values: is the score high enough? Does the password match?
tips: Use `==` for equality, `=` for assignment — never confuse them!
Comparisons produce Bools — perfect for `if` conditions
Chaining comparisons: `0 <= x && x <= 100` (can't write `0 <= x <= 100`)
Store complex comparisons in named variables for readability
common_mistakes: `if x = 5` instead of `if x == 5` — the classic bug
Chaining comparisons like math: `0 <= x <= 100` doesn't work in code
Using `==` with Float64 — floating-point rounding can cause surprises
